about: The turn-taking numbers every LEGION voice client uses. Kevin, 2026-11-22: 'all my voice agents should be the same'. The phone (app/.../service/turn/EndOfTurnPolicy.kt, BargeInGate.kt) and the web (server/frontend/src/assistant/turn/eot-policy.ts, barge-in-gate.ts) keep their own constants; SharedTurnSpecTest.kt and turn-spec.node.test.ts fail when either differs from this file, and both run cases.json. Change a number here and in both clients in one commit.

web_only.about: Numbers only the browser has, and why. Not the phone's to match.

why.speculate_ms: where an early transcript may start (off on the page, deps.ts EARLY_TRANSCRIPT)
why.echo_tail_ms: after a reply ends the browser cannot see its output latency, so this much mic audio is not a new turn
why.max_silero_ms: slower per window and the device cannot keep up: no models, energy end of turn, half-duplex
why.max_smart_ms: slower per check and Smart Turn is off: silence-only end at base_ms
why.engine_echo_counts_as_self_interrupt: a barge_in=1 turn the engine heard nothing in, or only the reply's words, counts once toward max_self_interrupts
